opening.argument: The presentation is a conventional HSN retail demonstration centered on a Dell laptop and the terms of purchasing it. The product is identified as an HSN “one-day-only Today's Special price,” with the description directing viewers “For More Info or to Buy Now” through an HSN product link. The offer is presented with ordinary product choices and support: viewers can select “with office or without office,” and “we give you five years of total tech support.” The presentation also states that “just your laptop alone would be $619,” while the visible HSN product frame shows retail pricing, today's special pricing, free shipping, and HSN purchasing information. These are standard commerce details for a product offering, with the closing celebratory graphic incidental to the retail presentation.
